title: Endpoint Telemetry: dns_query v1
description: Raw telemetry event emitted when a DNS query is made from an endpoint. Captured by an EDR agent or DNS inspection driver.

domain.description: The fully-qualified domain name (FQDN) queried. Normalizer maps this to the 'domain' field.

response_code.description: DNS response code returned by the resolver.

resolved_ips.description: List of IP addresses returned in the DNS response. Empty or null if no answer.

source_ip.description: IP address of the endpoint that issued the query.

process_name.description: Name of the process that made the DNS request.

pid.description: PID of the process that made the DNS request.
